name: mcp-server-development
description: Skill for developing and extending MCP servers

steps.details: Determine what the MCP tool should do and what parameters it needs
Add method to MCP server class with proper signature and return type
Update mcp-config.json to include the new tool in capabilities list
Implement try-except blocks and return proper error responses
Use logger to track tool usage and errors
Add docstring with parameters, return type, and example usage
Test the tool with an MCP client or inspector
